description: Company-mode report sections (Feature #01, M6). These sit ON TOP of the existing 10 general-report sections in interview/data/feedback_config.json when a session was run in company mode. Same schema (order/key/label/description/data_source/audience) so the existing report pipeline renders them unchanged. Student-vs-TPO visibility follows feedback_config.student_vs_tpo: the student sees every section except full integrity/proctoring detail (surfaced to them only as a soft 'flagged for review' note); the TPO sees everything.

sections.label: Company Result
sections.description: Top-line company outcome: the company + target track, the predicted track/verdict, confidence, and the terminal state (completed / eliminated at round X / terminated). Carries the blueprint's format_confidence + last_verified stamp so the student knows how current the format is.

sections.label: Round-by-Round Timeline
sections.description: Each round in order with its score, pass/borderline/fail badge, the deciding metric (percentile / problems solved / verdict), and any negative-marking note. 'Cleared Foundation -> cleared Advanced -> Bar Raiser: borderline' at a glance. Proctor actions on a round are TPO-only detail.

sections.label: Predicted Track & Gap to Next
sections.description: The predicted track with confidence, the cutoffs cleared vs missed for each track, and the concrete gap-to-next-track actions ('Solve 1 more coding problem to reach Elite'). This is the 'before the actual day' payoff.

sections.label: Attribute Breakdown
sections.description: Score (0-100) on each attribute the company actually evaluates on (TCS: verbal/reasoning/numerical/advanced-logic/coding; Google: general cognitive ability / role-related knowledge / leadership / Googleyness), weakest highlighted.

sections.label: Company-Specific Coaching
sections.description: Coaching tuned to this company's real rules and rounds: Wipro voice (filler-word rate + WPM), Amazon (measurable impact in LP stories), Cognizant (reach the max game level), Capgemini (Python is banned - practice C/C++/Java), TCS (clean-solve advanced coding for Prime), plus the weakest-attribute action. Always concrete, never 'do better'.

sections.label: Integrity & Proctoring (TPO)
sections.description: Full proctoring detail: tab-switch policy, events, review flags, and any termination. Conservative - flags for review, never auto-penalizes. TPO-only; the student sees only a soft 'session flagged for review' note when applicable.

student_vs_tpo.student_sees: company_headline, round_timeline (no proctor detail), track_prediction, attribute_breakdown, company_coaching; proctoring surfaces only as a soft 'session flagged for review' note.
student_vs_tpo.tpo_sees: Everything, including proctoring_detail and per-round proctor actions.
